data.name: Maurício
data.gender_notes: Maurício is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin 'Mauricius', which means 'Moor's ruler'. In Christian tradition, Maurício is a name of the Roman Emperor Mauricius, a devout Christian who ruled in the 6th century. He was a skilled warrior and is remembered for his military victories against the Persian and Avar invaders. The name Maurício carries the meaning “Moor's ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Maurício usually hope their child will grow to embody moor's ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Maurício belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moor's ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maurício total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_greek.name: Μαυρίκιος
in_greek.meaning: Μαυρίκιος σημαίνει αυτός που έρχεται από τη σκοτεινή θάλασσα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μαυρίκιος, που προέρχεται από το λατινικό Mauricius, σχετίζεται με το χαρακτηριστικό του να είναι απόγονος ή κάτοικος της σκοτεινής θάλασσας. Στην πρώιμη Εκκλησία, τέτοια ονόματα είχαν συχνά συμβολική σημασία, αντανακλώντας πνευματικές αρετές και την καταγωγή από το πνεύμα.

Maurício's adoption of Christianity was significant because the Britons were generally considered to be pagan at the time, and Maurício's conversion helped to spread Christianity throughout the region.
